hints.text: Add 0 and n to the cut positions and sort the combined cuts array.

hints.title: Interval State Representation
hints.text: Define dp(i, j) as the minimum cost to perform all cuts strictly between cut indices i and j.

hints.title: First Cut Choice
hints.text: For interval (i, j), try every candidate cut k strictly between i and j. The cost is cuts[j] - cuts[i] + dp(i, k) + dp(k, j).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all permutations of M cuts takes M! factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval dynamic programming memoizes all M^2 subsegments in O(M^3) time and O(M^2) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate augments cuts with stick endpoints and formulates classic matrix chain / burst balloons style interval DP.
